description: Your iOS listing in every App Store storefront: where the app is sold, which storefronts serve the fallback text or the fallback screenshots instead of their own language, and the second locale each storefront also indexes. Returns the last scan; `refresh: true` starts a new one when the last is older than 12 hours and answers 202 with `eta` seconds — call again after that. Depending on the workspace's plan the answer holds the full table or its preview.
